name: list_applications
summary: List installed applications (from Spotlight's index of .app bundles). Optionally narrow to those whose name contains a substring.

params.name: name_contains
params.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter application names by (e.g. 'safari'). Omit to list everything.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of applications to return (default 200, maximum 500).

name: search_applications
summary: Search installed applications by a name substring and return the matches. A focused alternative to list_applications when you already know part of the name.

params.name: query
params.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against application names (e.g. 'note').

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 50, maximum 500).

name: list_running_applications
summary: List the applications currently running with a visible presence (foreground apps, not background daemons). Requires permission to control System Events.

name: open_application
summary: Launch an application by name (or bring it to the front if already running). Runs immediately. If the app was not already running, undo will quit it again.

params.name: name
params.description: The application's name, e.g. 'Safari', 'Notes', 'Visual Studio Code'.

name: open_file
summary: Open a file, optionally in a specific application (e.g. a PNG in Preview). With 'app' given, the preview says whether that app appears to support the file's type and warns when it may not, and undo quits the app if it wasn't already running. Omit 'app' to open the file in its default application. STAGED for confirmation either way.

params.name: file
params.description: Path to the file to open (a leading ~ is expanded), e.g. '~/Downloads/Leah.png'.

params.name: app
params.description: The application to open the file with, e.g. 'Preview', 'TextEdit', 'Visual Studio Code'. Omit to use the file's default application.

name: focus_application
summary: Bring an already-running (or launchable) application to the front and give it focus. Runs immediately; cannot be undone. Requires permission to control the target app.

params.name: name
params.description: The application's name to bring to the front, e.g. 'Safari'.

name: quit_application
summary: Quit a running application. STAGED for confirmation because unsaved work could be lost, and relaunching is not a true reversal. Requires permission to control the target app.

params.name: name
params.description: The application's name to quit, e.g. 'Safari'.
